title: Gate A: box and look diff, ours against the oracle, report in parity/gate-a.json
gate: npm run gate: 81/81 on oracle-turn-1040 (1.3.0 baseline, decision 0011); zero cases fails; a lower count fails unless --accept
evidence: scripts/gate.mjs + scripts/oracle/collect.mjs (one instrument both sides) + app/src/routes/gate.$state.tsx; parity/gate-a.json Box cases (task-9350f7d5eee2c573, scripts/lib/box-cases.mjs): every box of 20x20 or more outside the conversation that paints and that no named case scores. Paints means the capture shows it drawing: a background colour that is not clear, a background image, a top border that shows, a box-shadow, an img, an svg that holds a drawn part (a path, shape, use, text or image the capture kept: an empty svg is what a broken icon looks like), or text of its own. A paintless wrapper is no case: its box comes from what it holds. A fill or top border paints only if, laid over what is behind it (the ancestors' backgrounds on the page's own background), it moves the pixel by 4/255 or more in some channel: a perception floor, not a number from a capture. So a 0.06 white hairline on rgb(18,18,18) paints (14) and a 0.01 fill or a fill the colour already behind it does not (2, 0). Behind unknown, so not scored: the oracle's captures predate the page's background (collect.mjs page), so a box of theirs that would paint only by a fill or top border and has no opaque ancestor is laid over a colour the capture does not hold. No colour is guessed: it is no case, the box of ours it pairs with is no extra, and the gate prints it as Unscored. There are 16, in 9 states, each a page-level modal backdrop (presentation 0,0 1040x760) or dialog: oracle-connect-apps, oracle-get-mobile, oracle-new-bot-dialog, oracle-settings, oracle-settings-computer, oracle-settings-permissions and oracle-settings-updates (backdrop and dialog), oracle-picture-viewer and oracle-picture-viewer-rest (dialog). The 1.3.0 captures hold page (decision 0011), so those 16 are known now; what stays unscored there is pinned (below). One count is lower on purpose (gate --accept, round 3 on #328): oracle-connect-apps 146 → 142. Six box cases that passed are no case now: its backdrop and dialog (behind unknown, above) and four 20x20 avatar rings under Your plugins (box:control:Your plugins › span#1-#4 at 767.7,102 to 809.7,102), each filled and top-bordered rgb(31,31,31) inside the rgb(31,31,31) dialog, so they move no pixel over what is behind them in the DOM. Known blind spot: behind means the ancestors only. The rings are stacked 14 apart, so each one's edge lies over the avatar before it, where it does show; a sibling drawn under a box is not in the model. Two cases pass that did not (box:page › header#1, box:page › div#1: page-wide pairing). A second is lower on purpose (round 3 cut): oracle-new-bot-dialog 119 → 118. box:control:heart character shape › span#1, Grok's 46x46 selected tile (rgba(245,245,245,0.22)), had passed by its centre against our 36x36 svg glyph; judged by its box it fails, box off by 5,5,-10,-10, because we draw no selected tile. No case changed for the empty-svg rule: every svg on both sides holds a drawn part. Known blind spot: the capture keeps no outline, no side or bottom border, no ::before/::after and no mask, so a box drawn only by those reads as paintless and is never scored. No box is scored twice: a named element (its box and look), its own box again, a box at the place of one already kept, the transcript's time row, the conversation (its articles, its log and the boxes that hold it: transcript and card cases) and an svg's parts are left out. Each box of the oracle's pairs with one of ours anywhere on the page, one to one, best overlap first: which named element holds a box is DOM nesting, not where it is drawn, so it never scopes the pairing. The floor is any overlap at all (IoU > 0): boxes that share no point are not one box. A pair passes within 1 pt on every edge, box only (its look is a later step). A text-less <i> is an icon glyph, drawn by a font or pseudo-element the capture cannot see: it paints and, as the oracle's box, is scored as an svg is (task-fe5a057a7e4b05b7). A box painted only by its top border is that line: it pairs by the strip it draws and passes on its two ends and its top edge, within 1 pt; a line need only be 20 long. The oracle's menu separators (account menu, between its groups at 431, 509.5 and 622) are in no captured element, so our two group lines there stay extra: a known blind spot. An svg of the oracle's pairs the same way but passes on its centre alone, within 1 pt, never its size: an svg's box is its viewBox, padding and all, and the capture keeps no ink, so where its drawing ends inside the box is a known blind spot (task-992182d31333922a). Only the oracle's: a box of the oracle's with a known size is judged by its box even when ours is an svg (round 3 cut: our 36 svg glyph had greened Grok's 46 selected tile). The capture keeps no fill or stroke, so an svg part drawn with neither still counts as drawn: a known blind spot. A box of the oracle's with no partner fails as missing, and a painted box of ours with none fails as extra, so either reds only itself and moves no other pairing (check 'box cases'). A hover state scores only what it changed, so it has none. Card parts (scripts/lib/cards.mjs) pair the same way, within their kind: best overlap first, one to one, IoU > 0, never by order, so one part shifted or one too many reds only itself (task-fe5a057a7e4b05b7). Recorded 2026-11-25 by a real run, re-recorded 2026-11-26 (invisible paint, below) and 2026-11-27 (the 1.3.0 baseline, below): box cases 420/489 pass over 33 states; card parts paired by overlap turned 2 card cases green (card#1 box#7 in oracle-main-720 and oracle-main-790 on 1.2.3), and none red. Per state: oracle-account-menu 12/15; oracle-ask-choice 5/6; oracle-choice-answered 5/6; oracle-composer-menu 12/12; oracle-connect-apps 29/38; oracle-edit-avatar 35/36; oracle-file-sent 5/6; oracle-file-waiting 7/8; oracle-get-mobile 12/15; oracle-language-picker 12/12; oracle-library 8/9; oracle-main-1000 12/12; oracle-main-1280 12/12; oracle-main-1600 12/12; oracle-main-2000 12/12; oracle-main-720 3/13; oracle-main-790 3/13; oracle-main-800 12/12; oracle-main-820 12/12; oracle-main-880 12/12; oracle-main-980 12/12; oracle-new-bot-dialog 37/39; oracle-panel-closed 6/6; oracle-picture-viewer-rest 17/18; oracle-picture-viewer 17/18; oracle-pictures-sent 5/6; oracle-pictures-waiting 10/12; oracle-settings-computer 16/20; oracle-settings-permissions 15/16; oracle-settings-updates 13/13; oracle-settings 16/24; oracle-turn-1040 12/12; oracle-voice-picker 12/20. Invisible paint is no paint (task-ebfec4c81747864d): a gradient's stops, a shadow's colours and text's colour pass the same 4/255 test as a fill, at the box's opacity as drawn (collect.mjs alpha: its own times its ancestors'; the oracle's 1.2.3 captures have none, so 1, never a guess), and a box whose opacity cannot move a pixel by 4/255 paints nothing. With behind unknown only the most a colour could move is known (its alpha times 255), so only one too clear to move any pixel is ruled out. 37 box cases that passed are no case now, each lower on purpose (gate --accept, 2026-11-26), and no other case moved: (a) box:page › header#1 in 33 states (oracle-account-menu, -ask-choice, -choice-answered, -composer-menu, -connect-apps, -edit-avatar, -file-sent, -file-waiting, -get-mobile, -language-picker, -library, -main-1000, -1280, -1600, -2000, -720, -790, -800, -820, -880, -980, -new-bot-dialog, -panel-closed, -picture-viewer-rest, -picture-viewer, -pictures-sent, -pictures-waiting, -settings-computer, -settings-permissions, -settings-updates, -settings, -turn-1040, -voice-picker): the header's only paint is linear-gradient(rgb(18, 18, 18), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)) over the page's rgb(18,18,18), which moves no pixel over its ancestors. It is a scrim that draws over scrolled content, not over its ancestors: a blind spot of 'behind' then, closed by pinned boxes (below, task-f7fdf44d2aa63bf3). (b) box:page › presentation#1 in 4 states (oracle-account-menu, -composer-menu, -language-picker, -voice-picker): the menu's only paint is a box-shadow list whose colours are all rgba(245, 245, 245, 0), Tailwind's ring and shadow variables at zero: clear, so no paint. Pinned boxes (task-f7fdf44d2aa63bf3): a box that is sticky, fixed or absolute (collect.mjs position) draws over whatever scrolls or sits under it, not over its ancestors, so its behind is unknown; so is a box inside one, until an opaque fill comes first on the way up. Such a box is judged by the bound test only (above). The 1.2.3 captures hold no position, so the rule moves nothing there (--ci stayed 2656/2754, parity/ unchanged).
